subject: Liz Mullane City Council Candidacy
overview: City Council candidate Liz Mullane introduced herself and outlined her platform and qualifications for the upcoming municipal election.

items.title: Candidate Statement of Liz Mullane
items.summary: Liz Mullane presented her professional background in fundraising and financial management, and outlined her campaign platform focusing on budget transparency, pedestrian safety, supporting local schools, and economic development.
